quizData.question: How do you handle an array of dynamic input fields in a form?

options.text: Use v-for on an array and bind each input with v-model to the array element
Use a separate component for each field
Use a watcher to update the array

quizData.explanation: You can use `v-for` to iterate over an array of values and bind each input to the corresponding array element, allowing dynamic addition/removal.
